record.short_description: Restore WAN BGP peer on AI-BRANCH-03 toward DEA-CLOUD
record.description: Implement the validated Dev twin change that restores the WAN BGP neighbor on AI-BRANCH-03. Scope is the single WAN interface and BGP neighbor session described in the change plan.
record.objective: Restore the AI-BRANCH-03 to DEA-CLOUD BGP adjacency without changing unrelated routing policy.
record.justification: Sustained path loss and a down BGP adjacency on AI-BRANCH-03. The change plan was validated on the Dev twin; this record tracks authorized production implementation.
record.work_notes:
Dev validation passed reachability and routing checks for AI-BRANCH-03. Production implementation is not started.

record.implementation_plan: On AI-BRANCH-03, restore the WAN interface addressing and BGP neighbor toward DEA-CLOUD exactly as recorded in the change plan. Do not modify access-layer VLANs.
record.risk_impact_analysis: Medium impact: WAN reachability for AI-BRANCH-03 may flap during the neighbor reset. Adjacent sites are out of scope.
record.test_plan: After implementation, confirm BGP established and ThousandEyes DEA-CLOUD-to-HQ loss returns to the pre-event baseline.
record.backout_plan: Re-apply the pre-change WAN interface and BGP neighbor configuration saved in the change plan and re-check adjacency.
